interface.shortDescription: Connect Nexts to the local VectorCraft desktop app.
interface.longDescription: Create and edit vector artwork, manage artboards, and export designs through the local VectorCraft desktop control channel. Requires VectorCraft to be installed and running with its control port enabled (vectorcraft --control 7979); the bundled MCP server connects to it with mcp --connect 127.0.0.1:7979. The control channel is loopback-only and unauthenticated, so no token is required. The plugin confirms the desktop app is reachable before editing, discovers available commands before execution, and keeps the project visible in the desktop application.
